cards.card_text: Together they attack and defeat Israel, and Eglon takes possession of the City of Palms.
cards.verse_text: After enlisting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join forces with him, Eglon attacked and defeated Israel, taking possession of the City of Palms.

cards.card_text: Deborah, a prophetess, is judging Israel, and the Israelites come to her for judgment under the Palm of Deborah.
cards.verse_text: And she would sit under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, where the Israelites would go up to her for judgment.

cards.card_text: All they find is her skull, her feet and the palms of her hands.
cards.verse_text: But when they went out to bury her, they found nothing but her skull, her feet, and the palms of her hands.
cards.snippet: …bury her, they found nothing but her skull, her feet, and the palms of her hands.

cards.card_text: The men bring the captives back to their brothers in ___, the City of Palms.

cards.snippet: Your stature is like a palm tree; your breasts are clusters of fruit.

cards.card_text: Inside, the walls are paneled with wood and carved all around with cherubim and palm trees, each cherub with a man's face toward one palm tree and a young lion's face toward the other.
cards.verse_text: In the space above the outside of the entrance to the inner sanctuary on all the walls, spaced evenly around the inner and outer sanctuary, were alternating carved cherubim and palm trees.
cards.snippet: …evenly around the inner and outer sanctuary, were alternating carved cherubim and palm trees.

cards.card_text: Both sanctuaries have double doors, and the outer sanctuary's doors are carved with cherubim and palm trees, just like the walls.
cards.verse_text: Cherubim and palm trees like those on the walls were carved on the doors of the outer sanctuary, and there was a wooden canopy outside, on the front of the portico.

cards.card_text: The whole harvest of the field has perished, and then Joel walks us through the orchard: the grapevine, the fig, the pomegranate, the palm, the apple.
cards.verse_text: The grapevine is dried up, and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, palm, and apple—all the trees of the orchard—are withered.
cards.snippet: …grapevine is dried up, and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, palm, and apple—all the trees of the orchard—are withered.
